t: Section 332(c)(1)(B) of title 37, United States Code, is amended by striking “$12,000” and inserting “$20,000”.

fable.w: This section only changes a dollar amount in title 37 (military pay and allowances) from $12,000 to $20,000. No tempting reading exists: it involves no consultation, comment period, hearing, advisory body, rulemaking authority, or right to sue, and no party outside the federal government takes part in any federal decision.
fable.s: is amended by striking “$12,000” and inserting “$20,000”
